Search.Name: Business Process BIVP Overview (in selected package)

RootTable.Filter: select bp.ea_guid AS CLASSGUID, bp.Object_Type AS CLASSTYPE,p5.name as [Package L3], p4.name as [Package L2], p3.Name as Package, p2.Name as Domain, bp.name as BusinessProcess, sc.Scope ,tvoa.Value as B,tvoi.VALUE as I, tvoc.VALUE as V, tvop.VALUE as P ,max(tva.VALUE) as [LDM B], max(tvi.VALUE) as [LDM I], max(tvc.VALUE) as [LDM V], max(tvp.VALUE) as [LDM P] from t_object bp inner join t_package p on p.Package_ID = bp.Package_ID inner join t_package p2 on p2.Package_ID = p.Parent_ID left join t_package p3 on p3.Package_ID = p2.Parent_ID left join t_package p4 on p4.Package_ID = p3.Parent_ID left join t_package p5 on p5.Package_ID = p4.Parent_ID left join t_objectproperties tvoa on tvoa.Object_ID = bp.Object_ID and tvoa.Property = 'Availability' left join t_objectproperties tvoi on tvoi.Object_ID = bp.Object_ID and tvoi.Property = 'Integrity' left join t_objectproperties tvoc on tvoc.Object_ID = bp.Object_ID and tvoc.Property = 'Confidentiality' left join t_objectproperties tvop on tvop.Object_ID = bp.Object_ID and tvop.Property = 'Privacy' left join (select c.Start_Object_ID, o.Name as Scope from t_connector c inner join t_object o on o.Object_ID = c.End_Object_ID and o.Stereotype = 'Archimate_BusinessInterface' where c.Stereotype = 'trace') sc on sc.Start_Object_ID = bp.Object_ID left join ( select lm.Object_ID, lm.Name, bp.Object_ID as BusinessProcessID from t_object bp inner join t_connector c on c.Stereotype = 'MessageFlow' and c.Start_Object_ID in (select distinct o.Object_ID from t_object o inner join t_object op on op.Object_ID = o.ParentID left join t_object op2 on op2.Object_ID = op.ParentID left join t_object op3 on op3.Object_ID = op2.ParentID where bp.Object_ID in (o.ParentID, op.ParentID, op2.ParentID, op3.ParentID)) inner join t_object so on so.Object_ID = c.Start_Object_ID inner join t_object eo on eo.Object_ID = c.End_Object_ID left join t_connectortag tv on tv.ElementID = c.Connector_ID and tv.Property = 'MessageRef' left join t_object msg on msg.ea_guid = tv.VALUE left join t_connector lmsg on lmsg.End_Object_ID = msg.Object_ID and lmsg.Stereotype = 'trace' left join t_object lm on lm.Object_ID = lmsg.Start_Object_ID and lm.Stereotype = 'LDM_Message' union select lm.Object_ID, lm.Name, bp.Object_ID as BusinessProcessID from t_object bp inner join t_object o on o.Stereotype = 'DataObject' and o.ParentID in (select distinct o.Object_ID from t_object o inner join t_object op on op.Object_ID = o.ParentID left join t_object op2 on op2.Object_ID = op.ParentID left join t_object op3 on op3.Object_ID = op2.ParentID where bp.Object_ID in (o.ParentID, op.ParentID, op2.ParentID, op3.ParentID)) left join t_connector ic on ic.End_Object_ID = o.Object_ID and ic.Stereotype = 'DataOutputAssociation' left join t_object so on so.Object_ID = ic.Start_Object_ID left join t_connector oc on oc.Start_Object_ID = o.Object_ID and oc.Stereotype = 'DataInputAssociation' left join t_object eo on eo.Object_ID = oc.End_Object_ID left join t_connector lmsg on lmsg.End_Object_ID = o.Object_ID and lmsg.Stereotype = 'trace' left join t_object lm on lm.Object_ID = lmsg.Start_Object_ID and lm.Stereotype = 'LDM_Message' ) lm on lm.BusinessProcessID = bp.Object_ID left join t_connector c on c.End_Object_ID = lm.Object_ID and c.Stereotype = 'trace' left join t_object o on c.Start_Object_ID = o.Object_ID and o.Stereotype = 'LDM_Message' and o.Name = lm.Name left join t_object o2 on o2.Package_ID = o.Package_ID left join t_attribute a on a.Object_ID = o2.Object_ID left join t_attributetag tv on tv.ElementID = a.ID and tv.Property = 'sourceAttribute' left join t_attribute a2 on a2.ea_guid = tv.VALUE left join t_attributetag tva on tva.ElementID = a2.ID and tva.Property = 'Availability' and tva.VALUE != 'TBD' left join t_attributetag tvi on tvi.ElementID = a2.ID and tvi.Property = 'Integrity' and tvi.VALUE != 'TBD' left join t_attributetag tvc on tvc.ElementID = a2.ID and tvc.Property = 'Confidentiality' and tvc.VALUE != 'TBD' left join t_attributetag tvp on tvp.ElementID = a2.ID and tvp.Property = 'Privacy' and tvp.VALUE != 'TBD' where bp.Stereotype = 'BusinessProcess' and bp.Package_ID in (#Branch#) group by bp.ea_guid, bp.Object_Type,p5.name, p4.name, p3.Name, p2.Name, bp.Name, tvoa.Value,tvoi.VALUE, tvoc.VALUE, tvop.VALUE, sc.Scope order by [Package L3], [Package L2], Package, Domain, BusinessProcess

select o.ea_guid AS CLASSGUID, o.Object_Type AS CLASSTYPE, case when package_p2.Name like '%MVP%' THEN 'MVP' when package_p2.Name like '%fase 2%' THEN 'Omnibus fase 2' ELSE 'Run-off' END as Section, case when package_p2.Name like '%SubProcess%' THEN 'SubProcess' ELSE 'Process' END as ProcessType, package_p1.Name as Domain, o.Name as ProcessName, processOwner.Name as ProcessOwner , p.name as PackageName ,package_p1.name as Package_level1,package_p2.name as Package_level2 ,package_p3.name as Package_level3 from t_object o inner join t_package p on p.Package_ID = o.Package_ID left join (select c.Start_Object_ID, o.Name from t_connector c inner join t_object o on o.Object_ID = c.End_Object_ID and o.Stereotype = 'PartnerRole' inner join t_connectortag tv on tv.Property = 'RA(S)CI' and tv.VALUE = 'A' and tv.ElementID = c.Connector_ID where c.Stereotype = 'trace') processOwner on processOwner.Start_Object_ID = o.Object_ID left join t_package package_p1 on package_p1.package_id = p.parent_id left join t_package package_p2 on package_p2.package_id = package_p1.parent_id left join t_package package_p3 on package_p3.package_id = package_p2.parent_id where o.Stereotype = 'BusinessProcess' order by Section, ProcessType, Domain, ProcessName

Search.Name: BP x Role x Functions matrix

RootTable.Filter: select act.CLASSGUID, act.CLASSTYPE, act.BusinessProcess, act.Activity, act.Rasci, act.Role, func.FunctionName, func.ReportsTo, func.EscalatesTo , act.PackageName ,act.Package_level1,act.Package_level2 ,act.Package_level3 from ( select act.ea_guid AS CLASSGUID, act.Object_Type AS CLASSTYPE , usr.Name as Role, usr.Rasci, act.Name as Activity, bp.Name as BusinessProcess , package.name as PackageName ,package_p1.name as Package_level1,package_p2.name as Package_level2 ,package_p3.name as Package_level3 , trf.End_Object_ID as functionID from t_object act left join (select au.Start_Object_ID, usr.Object_ID, usr.Name, tv.VALUE as Rasci from t_connector au inner join t_object usr on au.End_Object_ID = usr.Object_ID and usr.Stereotype = 'PartnerRole' left join t_connectortag tv on tv.ElementID = au.Connector_ID and tv.Property = 'RA(S)CI' where au.Stereotype = 'trace') usr on act.Object_ID = usr.Start_Object_ID left join t_object ln on act.ParentID = ln.Object_ID and ln.Stereotype = 'Lane' left join t_object pl on ln.ParentID = pl.Object_ID and pl.Stereotype = 'Pool' left join t_object bp on bp.Object_ID in (ln.ParentID, pl.ParentID) and bp.Stereotype = 'BusinessProcess' left join t_connector trf on trf.Start_Object_ID = usr.Object_ID and trf.Stereotype = 'trace' inner join t_package package on package.Package_ID = act.Package_ID left join t_package package_p1 on package_p1.package_id = package.parent_id left join t_package package_p2 on package_p2.package_id = package_p1.parent_id left join t_package package_p3 on package_p3.package_id = package_p2.parent_id where act.Stereotype = 'Activity' ) act full outer join ( select f.Object_ID, f.Name as FunctionName, mgr.Name as ReportsTo, esc.Name as EscalatesTo from t_object f left join t_connector c on c.Start_Object_ID = f.Object_ID and c.Stereotype = 'ArchiMate_Flow' left join t_object mgr on mgr.Object_ID = c.End_Object_ID and mgr.Stereotype in ('ArchiMate_BusinessRole', 'ArchiMate_BusinessCollaboration') left join t_connector ct on ct.Start_Object_ID = f.Object_ID and ct.Stereotype = 'ArchiMate_Triggering' left join t_object esc on esc.Object_ID = ct.End_Object_ID and esc.Stereotype in ('ArchiMate_BusinessRole', 'ArchiMate_BusinessCollaboration') where f.Stereotype = 'ArchiMate_BusinessRole' ) func on func.Object_ID = act.functionID order by BusinessProcess, act.Activity

Search.Name: Objects by CR or SD (in selected package)

RootTable.Filter:
SELECT o.ea_guid AS CLASSGUID, o.Object_Type AS CLASSTYPE, re.Name AS Release, cr.StereoType AS ChangeType, cr.Name AS ChangeRequest, o.name AS ChangedItem, substring(op.Notes, charindex('date=',op.[Notes]) + len('date='),10) as ChangeDate, substring(op.Notes,charindex('user=',op.[Notes]) + len('user='),charindex(';date=', op.[Notes]) - (charindex('user=',op.[Notes]) + len('user='))) as UserName, substring(op.Notes,charindex('comments=',op.[Notes]) + len('comments='),500) as ChangeComments, package.name AS PackageName, package_p1.name AS Package_level1, package_p2.name AS Package_level2, package_p3.name AS Package_level3 FROM ((((((((t_object o INNER JOIN t_objectproperties op ON o.Object_ID = op.Object_ID) INNER JOIN t_object cr ON cr.ea_guid = op.value) LEFT JOIN t_connector crre ON crre.Start_Object_ID = cr.Object_Id) LEFT JOIN t_object re ON (re.Object_Id = crre.End_Object_Id AND re.StereoType = 'Release')) INNER JOIN t_package package ON o.package_id = package.package_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p1 ON package_p1.package_id = package.parent_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p2 ON package_p2.package_id = package_p1.parent_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p3 ON package_p3.package_id = package_p2.parent_id) WHERE op.Property = 'CR' and cr.Name like '#WC#<Search Term>#WC#' AND o.Package_ID IN (#Branch#)
UNION
SELECT a.ea_guid AS CLASSGUID, 'Attribute' AS CLASSTYPE, re.Name AS Release, cr.StereoType AS ChangeType, cr.Name AS ChangeRequest, o.name +'.'+ a.Name AS ChangedItem, substring(atv.Notes, charindex('date=',atv.[Notes]) + len('date='),10) as ChangeDate, substring(atv.Notes,charindex('user=',atv.[Notes]) + len('user='),charindex(';date=', atv.[Notes]) - (charindex('user=',atv.[Notes]) + len('user='))) as UserName, substring(atv.Notes,charindex('comments=',atv.[Notes]) + len('comments='),500) as ChangeComments, package.name AS PackageName, package_p1.name AS Package_level1, package_p2.name AS Package_level2, package_p3.name AS Package_level3 FROM (((((((((t_attribute a INNER JOIN t_attributetag atv ON a.ID = atv.ElementID) INNER JOIN t_object cr ON cr.ea_guid = atv.value) LEFT JOIN t_connector crre ON crre.Start_Object_ID = cr.Object_Id) LEFT JOIN t_object re ON (re.Object_Id = crre.End_Object_Id AND re.StereoType = 'Release')) INNER JOIN t_object o ON a.Object_ID = o.Object_ID) INNER JOIN t_package package ON o.package_id = package.package_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p1 ON package_p1.package_id = package.parent_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p2 ON package_p2.package_id = package_p1.parent_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p3 ON package_p3.package_id = package_p2.parent_id) WHERE atv.Property = 'CR' and cr.Name like '#WC#<Search Term>#WC#' AND o.Package_ID IN (#Branch#) ORDER BY Release, ChangeType, ChangeRequest, ChangedItem

SELECT o.ea_guid AS CLASSGUID, o.Object_Type AS CLASSTYPE, re.Name AS Release, cr.StereoType AS ChangeType, cr.Name AS ChangeRequest, o.name AS ChangedItem, substring(op.Notes, charindex('date=',op.[Notes]) + len('date='),10) as ChangeDate, substring(op.Notes,charindex('user=',op.[Notes]) + len('user='),charindex(';date=', op.[Notes]) - (charindex('user=',op.[Notes]) + len('user='))) as UserName, substring(op.Notes,charindex('comments=',op.[Notes]) + len('comments='),500) as ChangeComments, package.name AS PackageName, package_p1.name AS Package_level1, package_p2.name AS Package_level2, package_p3.name AS Package_level3 FROM ((((((((t_object o INNER JOIN t_objectproperties op ON o.Object_ID = op.Object_ID) INNER JOIN t_object cr ON cr.ea_guid = op.value) INNER JOIN t_connector crre ON crre.Start_Object_ID = cr.Object_Id) INNER JOIN t_object re ON (re.Object_Id = crre.End_Object_Id AND re.StereoType = 'Release')) INNER JOIN t_package package ON o.package_id = package.package_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p1 ON package_p1.package_id = package.parent_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p2 ON package_p2.package_id = package_p1.parent_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p3 ON package_p3.package_id = package_p2.parent_id) WHERE op.Property = 'CR' AND re.Name LIKE '<Search Term>' AND o.Package_ID IN (#Branch#)
UNION ALL
SELECT a.ea_guid AS CLASSGUID, 'Attribute' AS CLASSTYPE, re.Name AS Release, cr.StereoType AS ChangeType, cr.Name AS ChangeRequest, o.name +'.'+ a.Name AS ChangedItem, substring(atv.Notes, charindex('date=',atv.[Notes]) + len('date='),10) as ChangeDate, substring(atv.Notes,charindex('user=',atv.[Notes]) + len('user='),charindex(';date=', atv.[Notes]) - (charindex('user=',atv.[Notes]) + len('user='))) as UserName, substring(atv.Notes,charindex('comments=',atv.[Notes]) + len('comments='),500) as ChangeComments, package.name AS PackageName, package_p1.name AS Package_level1, package_p2.name AS Package_level2, package_p3.name AS Package_level3 FROM (((((((((t_attribute a INNER JOIN t_attributetag atv ON a.ID = atv.ElementID) INNER JOIN t_object cr ON cr.ea_guid = atv.value) INNER JOIN t_connector crre ON crre.Start_Object_ID = cr.Object_Id) INNER JOIN t_object re ON (re.Object_Id = crre.End_Object_Id AND re.StereoType = 'Release')) INNER JOIN t_object o ON a.Object_ID = o.Object_ID) INNER JOIN t_package package ON o.package_id = package.package_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p1 ON package_p1.package_id = package.parent_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p2 ON package_p2.package_id = package_p1.parent_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p3 ON package_p3.package_id = package_p2.parent_id) WHERE atv.Property = 'CR' AND re.Name LIKE '<Search Term>' AND o.Package_ID IN (#Branch#) ORDER BY Release, ChangeType, ChangeRequest, ChangedItem

Search.Name: Role x Activity x Architecture Matrix

RootTable.Filter: select act.ea_guid AS CLASSGUID, act.Object_Type AS CLASSTYPE , usr.Name as Role, act.Name as Activity, bp.Name as BusinessProcess, apc.Name as ApplicationComponent, dv.Name as Device, loc.Name as Location , package.name as PackageName ,package_p1.name as Package_level1,package_p2.name as Package_level2 ,package_p3.name as Package_level3 from t_object act left join (select au.Start_Object_ID, usr.Object_ID, usr.Name from t_connector au inner join t_object usr on au.End_Object_ID = usr.Object_ID and usr.Stereotype = 'PartnerRole' where au.Stereotype = 'trace') usr on act.Object_ID = usr.Start_Object_ID left join t_object ln on act.ParentID = ln.Object_ID and ln.Stereotype = 'Lane' left join t_object pl on ln.ParentID = pl.Object_ID and pl.Stereotype = 'Pool' left join t_object bp on bp.Object_ID in (ln.ParentID, pl.ParentID) and bp.Stereotype = 'BusinessProcess' left join (select aac.Start_Object_ID, apc.Object_ID, apc.Name from t_connector aac inner join t_object apc on apc.Object_ID = aac.End_Object_ID and apc.Stereotype = 'EAM_ApplicationComponent' where aac.Stereotype = 'trace') apc on apc.Start_Object_ID = act.Object_ID left join (select apcd.End_Object_ID,dv.Object_ID, dv.Name from t_connector apcd inner join t_object dv on dv.Object_ID = apcd.Start_Object_ID and dv.Stereotype = 'EAM_Device' where apcd.stereotype = 'ArchiMate_Association') dv on dv.End_Object_ID = apc.Object_ID left join (select dvl.Start_Object_ID,Loc.Object_ID, Loc.Name from t_connector dvl inner join t_object loc on loc.Object_ID = dvl.End_Object_ID and Loc.Stereotype = 'EAM_Location' where dvl.stereotype = 'ArchiMate_Composition') loc on loc.Start_Object_ID = dv.Object_ID inner join t_package package on package.Package_ID = act.Package_ID left join t_package package_p1 on package_p1.package_id = package.parent_id left join t_package package_p2 on package_p2.package_id = package_p1.parent_id left join t_package package_p3 on package_p3.package_id = package_p2.parent_id where act.Stereotype = 'Activity' order by bp.Name, act.Name
